title: Dimension manifest (dimension.json)
description: The root of one content mod. Everything it lists is built into one pak.

id.description: Becomes the content root /Game/Dimensions/<id>/ and the pak name.

content.description: Glob patterns, relative to this file, for the definition files. Default: content/**/*.json

name.description: File name without extension. _P is added. Default: zz_Dimensions_<id>.

chunkId.description: Chunk the mod's assets are cooked into. Pick one no other mod of yours uses.

format.description: iostore writes .pak + .utoc + .ucas (the game's own format); legacy writes a plain .pak.
